summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py (added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member), rich/control.py (format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, plus Control.title classmethod), rich/console.py (set_window_title returning True when is_terminal, else False, with the specified docstring), rich/_windows_renderer.py (dispatch calling term.set_title with the control's second item), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200), and tests in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked manually. No commits were made.
